senses.simple: Moving or placed beside a long thing, like a road or river.

examples.en: We rode our bikes along the river.
Flowers grow along the fence.

senses.simple: With someone; together.

examples.en: Can my little brother come along?
We all sang along to the song.

senses.simple: In the middle of a group of things or people.

examples.en: A small house stood among the tall trees.
examples.ko: 키 큰 나무들 사이에 작은 집이 있었다.

examples.en: Can you find the red marble among the blue ones?
examples.ko: 파란 구슬들 사이에서 빨간 구슬을 찾을 수 있어?

senses.simple: Shared by a group, or one of a group.

examples.en: We shared the pizza among the four of us.
Pizza is among my favorite foods.
examples.ko: 피자는 내가 좋아하는 음식 중 하나다.

senses.simple: On every side of something, or in a circle.

examples.en: We sat around the campfire and told stories.
examples.ko: 우리는 모닥불 주위에 둘러앉아 이야기를 했다.

examples.en: The Earth moves around the sun.

senses.simple: In different places in an area.

examples.en: My toys are all around the room.
Let's walk around the zoo.

senses.simple: About; close to.

examples.en: I'll be home around five o'clock.
There are around 30 kids in my class.

senses.simple: Used to show a place where someone or something is.

examples.en: I'll meet you at the library.
My mom is at work right now.

senses.simple: Used to show an exact time.

examples.en: School starts at 8 o'clock.
We eat dinner at six.

senses.simple: Toward; in the direction of.

examples.en: Look at that huge rainbow!
The puppy barked at the mail carrier.

senses.simple: Earlier than something.

examples.en: Wash your hands before you eat.
I read a book before bed every night.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 밤 자기 전에 책을 읽는다.

senses.simple: At an earlier time; in the past.

examples.en: Have you been to this museum before?
examples.ko: 전에 이 박물관에 와 본 적 있어?

examples.en: I've never seen snow before!

senses.simple: At the back of something.

examples.en: The cat is hiding behind the couch.
Please stand behind the yellow line.

senses.simple: Slower or later than others; not keeping up.

examples.en: I was sick, so I fell behind in math.
Hurry up, you're getting left behind!

senses.simple: Lower than something; under it.

examples.en: Fish swim below the ice on the lake.
Write your name below the title.

senses.simple: Less than a number or amount.

examples.en: It was ten degrees below zero last night.
Kids below age five get in free.

senses.simple: Under or below something. It sounds a little like a storybook word.
senses.ko_simple: 어떤 것의 아래에 (책에서 자주 쓰는 말)

examples.en: The treasure was buried beneath the old oak tree.
examples.ko: 보물은 오래된 참나무 밑에 묻혀 있었다.

examples.en: We lay on the grass beneath the stars.

senses.simple: Next to; at the side of.

examples.en: My dog sleeps beside my bed.
examples.ko: 우리 개는 내 침대 옆에서 잔다.

examples.en: Come sit beside me.

senses.simple: Other than; in addition to.

examples.en: Besides soccer, I also play the violin.
Who else is coming besides your cousins?
examples.ko: 네 사촌들 말고 또 누가 와?

senses.simple: Also; and another reason is.

examples.en: I don't want to go out. Besides, it's raining.
We can't buy it. Besides, we don't need it.
examples.ko: 그건 살 수 없어. 게다가 필요하지도 않아.

senses.simple: In the space that separates two things.

examples.en: I sat between Mom and Dad at the movie.
The letter B comes between A and C.
examples.ko: 알파벳 B는 A와 C 사이에 있다.

senses.simple: After one time and before another time.

examples.en: Don't eat snacks between meals.
The store is closed between noon and 1 o'clock.

senses.simple: Shared by two people or things.

examples.en: Let's split the cookie between us.
This is a secret between you and me.

senses.simple: On the far side of something; farther than.

examples.en: There is a small village beyond the mountains.
Don't go beyond the fence.

senses.simple: More than; past what is possible.

examples.en: The math problem was beyond me.
examples.ko: 그 수학 문제는 내 실력으로는 무리였다.

examples.en: The garden was beautiful beyond words.
examples.ko: 정원은 말로 표현할 수 없을 만큼 아름다웠다.

senses.simple: Next to; near.

examples.en: Let's have a picnic by the lake.
My desk is by the window.

senses.simple: Used to show who did something, or how it was done.
senses.ko_simple: 누가 했는지, 또는 어떤 방법으로 했는지 나타내는 말

examples.en: This book was written by Roald Dahl.
We went to Grandma's house by train.
examples.ko: 우리는 기차를 타고 할머니 댁에 갔다.

senses.simple: Not later than a time.

examples.en: Please finish your homework by Friday.
Be home by dinnertime.

senses.simple: From a higher place to a lower place.

examples.en: The leaves fell down from the tree.
Please sit down.

senses.simple: Along a road or path.

examples.en: The ice cream truck drove down the street.
My friend lives just down the road.
examples.ko: 친구는 이 길 바로 저쪽에 산다.

senses.simple: All through a period of time, or at some point in it.

examples.en: Please don't talk during the movie.
We go camping during summer vacation.
examples.ko: 우리는 여름 방학 동안 캠핑을 간다.

senses.simple: Not including; but not.

examples.en: I like all vegetables except broccoli.
examples.ko: 나는 브로콜리만 빼고 모든 채소를 좋아한다.

examples.en: The store is open every day except Sunday.
examples.ko: 그 가게는 일요일 빼고 매일 연다.

senses.simple: Meant to be given to or used by someone.
senses.ko_simple: 누구에게 주거나 누구를 위한 것이라는 뜻

examples.en: I made this card for you!
This toothbrush is for the dog.

senses.simple: Used to show how long something goes on.

examples.en: We waited for two hours.
I have known her for three years.
examples.ko: 나는 그 애를 3년 동안 알고 지냈다.

senses.simple: Used to show the reason or purpose.

examples.en: Thank you for the present!
We went to the store for milk.

senses.simple: Used to show where someone or something starts or comes from.

examples.en: My grandparents are from Korea.
I got a letter from my pen pal.

senses.simple: Used to show the start of a time.

examples.en: The store is open from 9 to 5.
From now on, I will make my bed every day.
examples.ko: 이제부터 나는 매일 침대를 정리할 거야.

senses.simple: Inside something.

examples.en: The cookies are in the jar.
Fish live in the water.

senses.simple: During a month, year, season, or part of the day.
senses.ko_simple: 달, 해, 계절, 하루 중 어떤 때를 나타내는 말

examples.en: My birthday is in July.
I like to read in the morning.
examples.ko: 나는 아침에 책 읽는 걸 좋아한다.

senses.simple: Using a language or a way of doing something.

examples.en: Can you say "thank you" in Korean?
Please write in pencil, not pen.

senses.simple: In the inner part of something.

examples.en: There was a surprise inside the box.
examples.ko: 상자 안에 깜짝 선물이 들어 있었다.

examples.en: It's raining. Let's play inside.

senses.simple: The inner part of something.

examples.en: The inside of a watermelon is red and juicy.
My shirt is inside out!

senses.simple: Moving to the inside of something.

examples.en: The frog jumped into the pond.
Put your toys into the basket.

senses.simple: Used to show a change from one thing to another.
senses.ko_simple: 어떤 것이 다른 것으로 바뀜을 나타내는 말

examples.en: A caterpillar turns into a butterfly.
Cut the pie into eight pieces.

senses.simple: Not far away; close to.

examples.en: We live near the school.
Don't stand too near the fire.
examples.ko: 불에 너무 가까이 서 있지 마.

senses.simple: Belonging to or part of something.

examples.en: The color of the sky is blue.
I ate the top of the cupcake first.

senses.simple: Used to show an amount or a group.

examples.en: Can I have a glass of water?
examples.ko: 물 한 잔 마실 수 있어요?

examples.en: A lot of kids came to the party.

senses.simple: Used to show what something is made from or what it shows.
senses.ko_simple: 무엇으로 만들었는지, 무엇을 그렸는지 나타내는 말

examples.en: She wore a crown of flowers.
examples.ko: 그 애는 꽃으로 만든 왕관을 썼다.

examples.en: This is a picture of my family.

senses.simple: Away from a place or a surface.

examples.en: Take your shoes off at the door.
The cat jumped off the table.

senses.simple: Not working or not turned on.

examples.en: Turn off the lights when you leave.
The TV is off.

senses.simple: Not at work or school.

examples.en: Dad has the day off today.
We get Monday off for the holiday.

senses.simple: Touching the top of something.

examples.en: Your book is on the table.
A ladybug landed on my finger.

senses.simple: Used to show a day or date.

examples.en: We have art class on Tuesday.
My birthday party is on May 5th.

senses.simple: Working or turned on.

examples.en: Can you turn on the light?
Is the oven on?

senses.simple: Moving to a place on top of something.

examples.en: The cat jumped onto the counter.
Hold onto the railing on the stairs.

senses.simple: Away from the inside of a place or thing.

examples.en: Let's go out and play.
Take the cookies out of the oven.

senses.simple: Not at home or not here.

examples.en: Mom is out shopping right now.
Sorry, my brother is out.

senses.simple: Used up, finished, or not burning anymore.

examples.en: We are out of milk.
The candle went out.

senses.simple: Not inside a building or place; outdoors.

examples.en: The kids are playing outside.
Wait for me outside the classroom.

senses.simple: The outer part of something.

examples.en: The outside of the box is blue.
The outside of a coconut is hard and hairy.
examples.ko: 코코넛 겉은 딱딱하고 털이 나 있다.

senses.simple: Above something, or moving from one side to the other above it.
senses.ko_simple: 어떤 것의 위에, 또는 위를 넘어서

examples.en: The cow jumped over the moon.
A plane flew over our house.

senses.simple: More than.

examples.en: Over 100 people came to the school play.
This turtle is over fifty years old.

senses.simple: Finished; ended.

examples.en: Summer vacation is over.
The game is over. We won!

senses.simple: Going near something and then beyond it.

examples.en: We drove past the zoo on the way home.
The ball rolled past the goalie.

senses.simple: Later than a time.

examples.en: It's half past seven.
It's past your bedtime!

senses.simple: The time before now.

examples.en: In the past, people wrote letters with feather pens.
Dinosaurs lived in the distant past.

senses.simple: For each one.

examples.en: The tickets cost five dollars per person.
The car was going 30 miles per hour.

senses.simple: Into one side and out of the other side.

examples.en: The train went through a long tunnel.
Sunlight came through the window.

senses.simple: From the beginning to the end of something.

examples.en: The baby slept through the night.
I read through the whole book in one day.
examples.ko: 하루 만에 책을 처음부터 끝까지 다 읽었다.

senses.simple: Finished.

examples.en: Are you through with the scissors?
I'm through with my homework!

senses.simple: In every part of a place, or during the whole time.
senses.ko_simple: 어떤 곳의 모든 부분에, 또는 어떤 시간 동안 내내

examples.en: It rained throughout the day.
The smell of cookies spread throughout the house.
examples.ko: 쿠키 냄새가 온 집 안에 퍼졌다.

senses.simple: Moving in the direction of a place or person.

examples.en: We are going to the beach.
Give the ball to me!

senses.simple: Until; as far as.

examples.en: I can count from one to a hundred.
The store is open from 9 to 5.

senses.simple: Used before a verb, as in "to swim" or "to eat".

examples.en: I want to learn to swim.
We went to the store to buy milk.

senses.simple: In the direction of. "Towards" means the same thing.

examples.en: The puppy ran toward me.
Sunflowers turn toward the sun.

senses.simple: The same as "toward": in the direction of.
senses.ko_simple: 'toward'와 같은 말로, 어떤 것이 있는 쪽으로

examples.en: The boat sailed towards the island.
She walked towards the door.

senses.simple: Below something; covered by it.

examples.en: The cat is sleeping under the bed.
We sat under a tree to stay cool.
examples.ko: 우리는 시원하게 있으려고 나무 아래 앉았다.

senses.simple: Less than a number or age.

examples.en: Children under five eat for free.
This toy costs under ten dollars.

senses.simple: Under or below something, often hidden.
senses.ko_simple: 어떤 것 밑에 (가려져 있는 경우가 많음)

examples.en: I found my missing sock underneath the couch.
Wear a warm shirt underneath your jacket.

senses.simple: Different from.

examples.en: Unlike my sister, I love spicy food.
examples.ko: 언니와 달리 나는 매운 음식을 좋아한다.

examples.en: Unlike most birds, penguins cannot fly.
examples.ko: 대부분의 새와 달리 펭귄은 날 수 없다.

senses.simple: From a lower place to a higher place.

examples.en: The balloon floated up into the sky.
Please stand up.

senses.simple: To a higher part of something, or along it.

examples.en: The squirrel ran up the tree.
We climbed up the hill.

senses.simple: Awake and out of bed.

examples.en: Are you up yet? It's time for school.
examples.ko: 아직 안 일어났니? 학교 갈 시간이야.

examples.en: I stayed up late on New Year's Eve.
examples.ko: 새해 전날 밤에 늦게까지 안 잤다.

senses.simple: On. Used in stories and more formal writing.
senses.ko_simple: 'on'과 같은 뜻 (이야기책이나 격식 있는 글에서 씀)

examples.en: Once upon a time, there lived a brave princess.
A crow sat upon the branch.
examples.ko: 까마귀 한 마리가 나뭇가지 위에 앉았다.

senses.simple: Together with someone or something.

examples.en: I went to the park with my dad.
I like pancakes with syrup.

senses.simple: Using something.

examples.en: Cut the paper with scissors.
I eat rice with chopsticks.

senses.simple: Having something.

examples.en: The girl with the red hat is my sister.
examples.ko: 빨간 모자를 쓴 여자아이가 내 동생이다.

examples.en: I want a house with a big yard.
examples.ko: 나는 큰 마당이 있는 집을 갖고 싶다.

senses.simple: Inside a time or a space; not more than.

examples.en: Please answer within ten minutes.
The library is within walking distance.
examples.ko: 도서관은 걸어갈 수 있는 거리에 있다.

senses.simple: Not having something; with no.

examples.en: I can't see without my glasses.
examples.ko: 나는 안경 없이는 볼 수가 없다.

examples.en: He left without saying goodbye.

senses.simple: Even though something else is true.

examples.en: Despite the rain, we had fun at the zoo.
She kept running despite her sore foot.
examples.ko: 그 애는 발이 아픈데도 계속 달렸다.

senses.simple: Going through a place on the way, or using something to send.
senses.ko_simple: 어떤 곳을 거쳐서, 또는 무엇을 통해서

examples.en: We flew to Seoul via Tokyo.
Grandma sent the photos via email.

senses.simple: A form of "be" that you use with "I", as in "I am happy".

examples.en: I am nine years old.
I am at the library right now.

senses.simple: Used with "I" and an -ing verb to say what you are doing now.
senses.ko_simple: 'I am + -ing'로 지금 하고 있는 일을 말할 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: I am reading a funny book.
I am going to the park later.

senses.simple: A form of "be" that you use with "he", "she", "it", or one person or thing.
senses.ko_simple: 'be'를 '그', '그녀', '그것'이나 한 사람·한 물건과 함께 쓸 때의 모양

examples.en: My sister is very funny.
The ball is under the table.

senses.simple: Used with an -ing verb to say what someone or something is doing now.
senses.ko_simple: '+ -ing'로 지금 하고 있는 일을 말할 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: The baby is sleeping, so be quiet.
It is snowing outside!

senses.simple: A form of "be" that you use with "you", "we", "they", or more than one person or thing.

examples.en: You are my best friend.
The cookies are in the oven.

senses.simple: Used with an -ing verb to say what people or things are doing now.
senses.ko_simple: '+ -ing'로 지금 하고 있는 일을 말할 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: We are playing hide-and-seek.
Are you coming to my party?

senses.simple: The past form of "be" used with "I", "he", "she", "it", or one person or thing.

examples.en: I was sick yesterday.
The movie was really scary.

senses.simple: Used with an -ing verb to say what was happening at a time in the past.
senses.ko_simple: '+ -ing'로 과거에 하고 있던 일을 말할 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: I was sleeping when the thunder started.
examples.ko: 천둥이 치기 시작했을 때 나는 자고 있었다.

examples.en: She was eating lunch when I called.
examples.ko: 내가 전화했을 때 그녀는 점심을 먹고 있었다.

senses.simple: The past form of "be" used with "you", "we", "they", or more than one.

examples.en: We were at the beach all day.
You were right about the weather.

senses.simple: Used with an -ing verb to say what people were doing at a time in the past.
senses.ko_simple: '+ -ing'로 과거에 하고 있던 일을 말할 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: They were playing soccer when it started to rain.
examples.ko: 비가 오기 시작했을 때 그들은 축구를 하고 있었다.

examples.en: What were you doing last night?

senses.simple: To exist, or to have a certain quality or job. Its forms are am, is, are, was, were, been.
senses.ko_simple: 어떤 상태이거나 무엇이라는 뜻 (am, is, are, was, were, been으로 모양이 바뀜)

examples.en: I want to be an astronaut when I grow up.
examples.ko: 나는 커서 우주 비행사가 되고 싶다.

examples.en: Please be quiet in the library.

senses.simple: Used with other verbs, as in "will be going" or "can be fixed".
senses.ko_simple: 다른 동사와 함께 쓰여 미래나 '~되다'를 나타내는 말

examples.en: I will be waiting for you at the gate.
Your bike can be fixed by tomorrow.
examples.ko: 네 자전거는 내일까지 고칠 수 있어.

senses.simple: A form of "be" used after "have", "has", or "had".

examples.en: I have been to Korea three times.
examples.ko: 나는 한국에 세 번 가 봤다.

examples.en: It has been a long day.

senses.simple: Used with an -ing verb to say something started in the past and is still going on.
senses.ko_simple: '+ -ing'로 과거부터 지금까지 계속하고 있는 일을 말할 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: I have been waiting for an hour!
It has been raining all week.

senses.simple: The -ing form of "be".

examples.en: Thank you for being so kind.
Stop being silly and eat your dinner.

senses.simple: A living thing, like a person or an animal.

examples.en: Human beings need water to live.
The story was about beings from another planet.
examples.ko: 그 이야기는 다른 행성에서 온 생명체에 관한 것이었다.

senses.simple: To perform an action or a job.

examples.en: I do my homework right after school.
examples.ko: 나는 학교 끝나고 바로 숙제를 한다.

examples.en: What do you want to do this weekend?

senses.simple: Used to make questions and "not" sentences, as in "Do you like it?" and "I don't know."
senses.ko_simple: 질문이나 '아니다' 문장을 만들 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: Do you like chocolate ice cream?
I don't know the answer.

senses.simple: The form of "do" used with "he", "she", "it", or one person or thing.

examples.en: My brother does the dishes after dinner.
She does gymnastics every Saturday.

senses.simple: Used to make questions and "not" sentences with "he", "she", or "it".
senses.ko_simple: '그', '그녀', '그것'이 있는 질문이나 '아니다' 문장을 만들 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: Does your dog bite?
My cat doesn't like baths.

senses.simple: The past form of "do".

examples.en: I did all my chores this morning.
You did a great job on your project!

senses.simple: Used to make questions and "not" sentences about the past.
senses.ko_simple: 지난 일에 대한 질문이나 '아니다' 문장을 만들 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: Did you see the fireworks last night?
I didn't hear the alarm.

senses.simple: A form of "do" used after "have", "has", or "had".

examples.en: I have done my homework already.
What have you done to your hair?

senses.simple: Finished.

examples.en: Are you done with the scissors?
The cookies are done. Let's eat!

senses.simple: To own or hold something.

examples.en: I have a pet hamster.
Do you have a pencil I can borrow?

senses.simple: To eat or drink, or to experience something.

examples.en: Let's have pizza for dinner.
We had a great time at the zoo.

senses.simple: Used with a past verb form to talk about things that have already happened. "Have to" means must.
senses.ko_simple: 이미 일어난 일을 말할 때 쓰는 말. 'have to'는 '~해야 한다'

examples.en: I have finished my book.
I have to clean my room before I can play.

senses.simple: The form of "have" used with "he", "she", "it", or one person or thing.

examples.en: My friend has a trampoline in her yard.
A spider has eight legs.

senses.simple: Used with "he", "she", or "it" to talk about things that have already happened. "Has to" means must.
senses.ko_simple: 이미 일어난 일을 말할 때 쓰는 말. 'has to'는 '~해야 한다'

examples.en: The bus has already left.
He has to go to the dentist today.

senses.simple: The past form of "have".

examples.en: I had cereal for breakfast.
We had so much fun at the party.

senses.simple: Used to talk about something that happened before another thing in the past. "Had to" means you needed to.
senses.ko_simple: 과거보다 더 전에 일어난 일을 말할 때 쓰는 말. 'had to'는 '~해야 했다'

examples.en: When we got there, the show had already started.
examples.ko: 우리가 도착했을 때 공연은 이미 시작했었다.

examples.en: I had to wait in line for an hour.
examples.ko: 나는 한 시간 동안 줄을 서야 했다.
